headline: Omar Fernández questions increase in fiscal deficit by 85,000 million pesos
summary: Senator Omar Fernández questioned a projected revenue reduction of over 31 billion pesos and a supplementary budget that would raise the fiscal deficit by more than 85 billion pesos. He said this came five months after a tax reform.
why: Fiscal deficits and revenue plans influence government debt levels and investor confidence in sovereign bonds.
original_headline: Omar fernández cuestiona aumento del déficit fiscal en 85,000 millones de pesos
